notes: TBox revision (migrated 2026-11-11 to the new layout: three propositional queries, three determinate derived queries, no worlds or indeterminate queries). No real exceptions: the GPL is a free software license, so every program under it is free and open-source (dual licensing adds terms but does not remove the GPL grant). The derived queries name made-up programs licensed under the GPL in the prompt (Quillpad, Larkspur, Nimbleway), so the class rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application (a software policy decides whether it may be installed). The negation is asked as "is it true that ... are not ..." (the "is it false that" form was misread by two models). The near query was changed from "Is the MIT License a copyleft license?", which two models answered wrongly before any edit, to the publisher of the GPL (the Free Software Foundation): same subject area, unaffected by the edit, and its answer differs from the new one.
